output.title: Streakly — Habit Tracker That Forgives
output.tagline: Repair missed days. Weekly targets. No guilt spiral.
output.description_short: Streakly is a beta habit tracker that lets you repair a missed day within the week — so one slip never kills your streak again.
output.description_long:
**Missed a day? Repair it. Your streak survives real life.**

Streakly is a habit tracker built for people who have already quit two or three habit apps. You know the pattern: one missed day breaks the streak, the streak was the motivation, and the app gets deleted in the guilt spiral that follows.

Streakly works differently:

- **Streak repair** — double up within the week and your chain stays alive. One slip is not a failure.
- **Weekly-target scoring** — habits are measured against weekly goals, not unbroken daily chains. Designed around behavior-change research, not gamified shame.
- **Private by default** — everything stays on your device. No account required, no social feed, no leaderboards.

**Currently in public beta.** 41% of an 800-person TestFlight cohort were still tracking at day 30 — well above the industry norm. Rated 4.8 stars across 96 beta reviews.

Streak repair was the most-requested feature from early testers. It ships as the core mechanic, not a paid add-on.

If a fresh start is what brought you here, Streakly is built to make sure it sticks this time.
screenshot_order: 1st: The streak repair moment — show a missed day being repaired and the streak counter staying intact. This is the core differentiator and the emotional hook that converts browsers who have been burned before.
2nd: Weekly target view — show the weekly scoring dashboard so users immediately see this is not a daily-chain app. Contrast with the familiar broken-streak screen they dread.
3rd: Privacy / simplicity screen — show the clean habit list with an on-device badge or no-account callout. Reassures users who are tired of social feeds and leaderboards.

faq.q: What happens if I miss a day?
faq.a: You can repair it. Complete the habit twice within the same week and your streak stays intact. One missed day is not the end.
Yes, Streakly is free during its public beta. A premium plan is planned for the future; beta users will hear about it first.

faq.q: Does Streakly need an account or internet connection?
faq.a: No account required. All your habit data is stored privately on your device by default.

faq.q: How is this different from Streaks, Habitify, or Habitica?
faq.a: Those apps punish a missed day by breaking your streak. Streakly scores against weekly targets and lets you repair slips — so the motivation survives real life.
It is in public beta with weekly builds. Core features including streak repair are live and stable. 800 testers have been using it for months.

output.cta: Join the beta free — start a streak that survives real life.
